set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/temporary-file-symlink-defense
stage=$(mktemp /tmp/export-script.XXXXXX)
cleanup_stage() { rm -f -- "$stage"; }
trap cleanup_stage EXIT HUP INT TERM
cat > "$stage" <<'ANTRIEB_EXPORT_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s OUTPUT\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
out=$1
out_dir=$(dirname -- "$out")
out_name=$(basename -- "$out")

umask 077
tmp_dir=''
tmp_file=''
cleanup() {
    if [ -n "$tmp_file" ]; then
        rm -f -- "$tmp_file"
    fi
    if [ -n "$tmp_dir" ]; then
        rmdir -- "$tmp_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 129' HUP
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM

tmp_dir=$(mktemp -d "$out_dir/.${out_name}.tmp.XXXXXX")
tmp_file=$tmp_dir/export
cat -- "$base/invoices.csv" > "$tmp_file"

# -T makes the destination pathname itself the rename target.  In particular,
# an existing symlink is replaced rather than followed.
mv -fT -- "$tmp_file" "$out"
tmp_file=''
rmdir -- "$tmp_dir"
tmp_dir=''
ANTRIEB_EXPORT_EOF
chmod 0755 "$stage"
install -o root -g root -m 0755 "$stage" bin/export
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
cleanup_stage
stat -c '%A %U:%G %s %n' bin/export
sed -n '1,240p' bin/export

set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/temporary-file-symlink-defense
work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/export-verification.XXXXXX)
cleanup_verify() {
    rm -f -- "$base/tmp/export.tmp"
    rm -rf -- "$work"
}
trap cleanup_verify EXIT HUP INT TERM

sentinel_before=$(sha256sum "$base/protected.txt" | awk '{print $1}')
source_before=$(sha256sum "$base/invoices.csv" | awk '{print $1}')
ln -s "$base/protected.txt" "$base/tmp/export.tmp"
ln -s "$base/protected.txt" "$work/symlink-output.csv"
"$base/bin/export" "$work/symlink-output.csv"
[ ! -L "$work/symlink-output.csv" ]
cmp -s "$base/invoices.csv" "$work/symlink-output.csv"
[ "$(sha256sum "$base/protected.txt" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$sentinel_before" ]
printf 'symlink-defense=PASS output-type=%s source=%s output=%s sentinel=%s\n' "$(stat -c %F "$work/symlink-output.csv")" "$source_before" "$(sha256sum "$work/symlink-output.csv" | awk '{print $1}')" "$(sha256sum "$base/protected.txt" | awk '{print $1}')"

i=1
while [ "$i" -le 24 ]; do
    "$base/bin/export" "$work/concurrent-$i.csv" &
    i=$((i + 1))
done
wait
i=1
while [ "$i" -le 24 ]; do
    cmp -s "$base/invoices.csv" "$work/concurrent-$i.csv"
    i=$((i + 1))
done
printf 'concurrent-exports=PASS count=24 rows-per-output=%s\n' "$(wc -l < "$base/invoices.csv")"

printf '%s\n' 'prior-destination-content' > "$work/prior.csv"
chmod 1777 "$work"
chmod 0444 "$work/prior.csv"
prior_before=$(sha256sum "$work/prior.csv" | awk '{print $1}')
set +e
runuser -u nobody -- "$base/bin/export" "$work/prior.csv" >/tmp/export-expected-failure.out 2>&1
failure_rc=$?
set -e
[ "$failure_rc" -ne 0 ]
prior_after=$(sha256sum "$work/prior.csv" | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$prior_before" = "$prior_after" ]
leftovers=$(find "$work" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '.*.tmp.*' -print)
[ -z "$leftovers" ]
printf 'failure-preserves-prior=PASS rc=%s before=%s after=%s\n' "$failure_rc" "$prior_before" "$prior_after"
printf 'temporary-cleanup=PASS private-temp-dirs=0\n'
printf 'source-preserved=%s sentinel-preserved=%s\n' "$(sha256sum "$base/invoices.csv" | awk '{print $1}')" "$(sha256sum "$base/protected.txt" | awk '{print $1}')"
rm -f /tmp/export-expected-failure.out
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
cleanup_verify
